# Stick It Out

> Stick It Out sells structured drum training from Michael Staus (Mike Staus): a weekly lesson membership, and a kick-and-hand coordination book as a PDF. The focus is control, timing and feel: hands, feet and pocket. The site is https://stickitoutbook.com/.

## What this site sells

- Lessons membership: one lesson a week (about 10 minutes) plus a written practice routine. Founding rate $19.99/month or $149/year, limited to the first 100 members, then $29.99/month. Checkout is not live yet. Join the founding member waitlist with an email. No card required.
- The book: "Stick It Out", a kick-and-hand coordination system by Michael Staus. PDF $19.99. Included with the founding annual plan. Print edition is planned for summer.

## Pages

- Home (membership): https://stickitoutbook.com/
- Book: https://stickitoutbook.com/book/
- Book checkout: https://stickitoutbook.com/payment/

## Instructor

- Michael Staus, studio and touring drummer based in Billings, MT. Studied at Berklee College of Music.
